page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from other tenants.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge offers a high-density compute profile with dedicated resources, though the lack of bundled local storage and GPU accelerators represents a tradeoff for workloads requiring direct-attached NVMe drives or hardware-accelerated graphics processing. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, and database hosting.
